question: What was total net revenue in 2025-Q2?

gold.sql: WITH lines AS ( SELECT oi.order_item_id, oi.product_id, o.order_id, o.order_date, o.ship_region_id, o.customer_id, o.channel, oi.quantity, oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount - COALESCE(r.refund, 0) AS net, oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.qret, 0) AS net_units FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund, SUM(quantity_returned) AS qret FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id) r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id WHERE o.status IN ('shipped', 'completed') AND c.is_test_account = FALSE) SELECT SUM(net) AS value FROM lines WHERE order_date >= '2025-04-01' AND order_date < '2025-07-01'

question: What was our gross margin in 2025-Q4?

gold.sql: WITH lines AS ( SELECT oi.order_item_id, oi.product_id, o.order_id, o.order_date, o.ship_region_id, o.customer_id, o.channel, oi.quantity, oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount - COALESCE(r.refund, 0) AS net, oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.qret, 0) AS net_units FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund, SUM(quantity_returned) AS qret FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id) r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id WHERE o.status IN ('shipped', 'completed') AND c.is_test_account = FALSE), cost_lines AS ( SELECT l.*, l.net_units * pc.unit_cost AS cogs FROM lines l JOIN product_costs pc ON pc.product_id = l.product_id AND pc.effective_from <= l.order_date AND (pc.effective_to IS NULL OR l.order_date < pc.effective_to)) SELECT (SUM(net) - SUM(cogs)) * 1.0 / SUM(net) AS value FROM cost_lines WHERE order_date >= '2025-10-01' AND order_date < '2026-01-01'

question: Which 3 categories had the highest gross margin in 2025?

gold.sql: WITH lines AS ( SELECT oi.order_item_id, oi.product_id, o.order_id, o.order_date, o.ship_region_id, o.customer_id, o.channel, oi.quantity, oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount - COALESCE(r.refund, 0) AS net, oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.qret, 0) AS net_units FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund, SUM(quantity_returned) AS qret FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id) r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id WHERE o.status IN ('shipped', 'completed') AND c.is_test_account = FALSE), cost_lines AS ( SELECT l.*, l.net_units * pc.unit_cost AS cogs FROM lines l JOIN product_costs pc ON pc.product_id = l.product_id AND pc.effective_from <= l.order_date AND (pc.effective_to IS NULL OR l.order_date < pc.effective_to)) SELECT cat.category_name AS category, (SUM(cl.net) - SUM(cl.cogs)) * 1.0 / SUM(cl.net) AS gross_margin FROM cost_lines cl JOIN products p ON p.product_id = cl.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id WHERE cl.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND cl.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY cat.category_name ORDER BY gross_margin DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 regions had the highest gross profit growth in 2025-Q3 versus the prior quarter?

gold.sql: WITH lines AS ( SELECT oi.order_item_id, oi.product_id, o.order_id, o.order_date, o.ship_region_id, o.customer_id, o.channel, oi.quantity, oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount - COALESCE(r.refund, 0) AS net, oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.qret, 0) AS net_units FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund, SUM(quantity_returned) AS qret FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id) r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id WHERE o.status IN ('shipped', 'completed') AND c.is_test_account = FALSE), cost_lines AS ( SELECT l.*, l.net_units * pc.unit_cost AS cogs FROM lines l JOIN product_costs pc ON pc.product_id = l.product_id AND pc.effective_from <= l.order_date AND (pc.effective_to IS NULL OR l.order_date < pc.effective_to)), g AS (SELECT rg.region_name AS region, SUM(CASE WHEN cl.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND cl.order_date < '2025-10-01' THEN cl.net - cl.cogs ELSE 0 END) AS cur, SUM(CASE WHEN cl.order_date >= '2025-04-01' AND cl.order_date < '2025-07-01' THEN cl.net - cl.cogs ELSE 0 END) AS prev FROM cost_lines cl JOIN regions rg ON rg.region_id = cl.ship_region_id GROUP BY rg.region_name) SELECT region, (cur - prev) * 1.0 / prev AS profit_growth FROM g ORDER BY profit_growth DESC LIMIT 3

question: What was the monthly customer retention rate for each month from June to December 2025?

gold.sql: WITH active AS ( SELECT DISTINCT o.customer_id, cal.year, cal.month, c.segment, c.home_region_id FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN calendar cal ON cal.date_key = o.order_date WHERE o.status IN ('shipped', 'completed') AND c.is_test_account = FALSE) SELECT cur.month, COUNT(nxt.customer_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS retention FROM active cur LEFT JOIN active nxt ON nxt.customer_id = cur.customer_id AND nxt.year = 2025 AND nxt.month = cur.month + 1 WHERE cur.year = 2025 AND cur.month BETWEEN 5 AND 11 GROUP BY cur.month
